_comment: Kill Tallies from docs/design/bestiary.md#kill-tallies. The slice ships the three perks of its three enemy types. A perk never grants traversal or opens a gate: reveal perks only show things.

echolocation_ping.name: Echolocation Ping
echolocation_ping.text: Ping: highlights breakable walls within 1 screen. It reveals them; it does not break them.

satellite_uplink.name: Satellite Uplink
satellite_uplink.text: Toggle: the minimap shows item locations in the current room.
satellite_uplink.text_ex: Uplink EX: also shows items in adjacent rooms.
